romarienkirche.name: St. Mary's Church
romarienkirche.slogan: A clock that has kept the calendar since 1472.
romarienkirche.line: Hans Düringer of Nuremberg built the astronomical clock in 1472; its calendar runs until 2150.

roleuchtturm.name: Warnemünde Lighthouse
roleuchtturm.slogan: Warnemünde's landmark, watching over the Baltic harbour mouth.
roleuchtturm.line: Built 1897-98 by harbour director Friedrich Kerner, it stands 36.9 metres tall.

romuenster.name: Doberan Minster
romuenster.slogan: Brick Gothic at its finest, raised by Cistercian monks.
romuenster.line: Legend says monks chose the site after a swan called out "dobr", Slavic for good, giving Doberan its name.

rokurhaus.name: Heiligendamm Kurhaus
rokurhaus.slogan: White classicist villas along the sea where the Baltic spa began.
rokurhaus.line: Founded in 1793, Heiligendamm is the oldest seaside spa in continental Europe and hosted the 2007 G8 summit.

rokroepelinertor.name: Kröpeliner Tor
rokroepelinertor.slogan: A 54-metre gate built to impress Hanseatic travellers.
rokroepelinertor.line: Around 1400 the citizens added five storeys to the original two, to show visitors Rostock's Hanseatic importance.
